title: Fold & Unfold
description: Precreases are folded and opened again to make guide lines.

steps.title: Horizontal crease
steps.instruction: Fold bottom edge to top edge, then unfold.
tips: Sharp precreases make later steps easier.
mistakes: Creasing only part of the way across.

steps.title: Vertical crease
steps.instruction: Fold left edge to right edge, then unfold.
tips: Use the first crease to check the edges are square.
mistakes: Folding along the old crease again.

steps.title: Diagonal crease
steps.instruction: Fold corner to corner, then unfold.
tips: The diagonal should pass exactly through the centre.

steps.title: Other diagonal
steps.instruction: Fold the other corners together, then unfold.
tips: All four creases should meet at one point.
steps.check: Four creases meeting at the centre.
